#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pii;

const ll INF = 1e18;
const long double EPS = 1e-15;

ll n, x, y;
long double best_diff = INF;
pii best_pair;

void try_update(ll denom, ll num) {
    if (denom <= 0) return;
    long double val = static_cast<long double>(num) / denom;
    long double target = static_cast<long double>(x) / y;
    long double diff = std::abs(val - target);
    
    if (diff + EPS < best_diff) {
        best_diff = diff;
        best_pair = {denom, num};
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    
    for (ll b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        ll a_floor = (x * b) / y;
        try_update(b, a_floor);
        try_update(b, a_floor + 1);
    }
    
    cout << best_pair.second << "/" << best_pair.first << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
